name: Bahamas Choice Real Estate
brand_truth: A small Nassau family brokerage, since 2013, that listens first and handles a property move end to end on whichever island it leads.
buyer: Overseas buyers and investors researching for months, and Bahamian families selling family property from abroad.

direction.why: Their listing photos are portrait 800x1066, which fill a fixed half-screen window at native size; the fixed window turns a real listing into a room-by-room walk-through for buyers abroad. A calm serif suits a family firm that sells by listening.

big_idea: A fixed window on the left walks an overseas buyer through 5 Bayview Drive room by room as the right column scrolls, then every live listing, island and agent.
pitch_line: Your own client says you sold her mother's house from abroad in four months; this site lets the next overseas buyer stand inside your listing before they ever call.
assumptions: Film chapter lines describe what the listing photos show; amenities from MLS #68204.
Sherry Morris and Erica Pinder shown without titles (none published).
66392 (rental) and 68204 (sale) share address and size on the MLS; shown as two listings as published.
